content.short: TeddySwap is an open-source decentralized exchange AMM protocol focusing on stablecoins.
content.description: TeddySwap aims to be an open-source and secure decentralized exchange AMM protocol focusing on stablecoins in the Cardano ecosystem. Our protocol is developed by former Cardano Foundation developers and the creators of plu-ts, a smart contract framework built to efficiently deploy Cardano dApps.
